notes.title: Bug fixes and changes
notes.content:
Everything changed:
[list]
[*]Changed how much stat increases when hanging out with a party member
[*]Fixed some text with a late game map notification popping up early
[*]Nerfed the sniper rifle to have a range of 5-30 tiles, but with a 40% hit chance
[*]Changed the level scaling slightly for enemies
[*]Small changes to the damage to location stability that is done with early game enemy groups when areas are left undefended
[*]Changed the decay amount each location gets per day from 5% to 7%.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes and gameplay changes
notes.content:
Here are all of the changes
[list]
[*] Made it more clear than F4 puts the game into full screen.
[*] Added more starting locations for each map, allowing more choice in planning where units will be.
[*] Buffed the Sniper Rifle to have unlimited range outside of 5 tiles near the user, but with a lower hit change (30%)
[*] Made it visually more clear where unit starting placements are.
[*] Changed some text to be clearer.
[*]Changed the stats to some enemy weapons to compensate for the Sniper Rifle buffs.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fix and some smaller changes
